title: Final Vault Boss
mission: Sort a fresh vault from scratch and unlock the final door
briefing: The last door. A new vault, unsorted, and no help from the mechanism this time. Phase one: build a valid Max Heap by hand. Phase two: take the root again and again until the active heap is empty. The door opens only when the array reads in ascending order from first index to last - the complete Heap Sort, build then extract, exactly as you have practised it.
hints: Phase one is level 4.1 again: start at the last parent and sift each one down.
You cannot extract until the heap is valid, because the root would not be the maximum.
Build is O(n) and the n extractions cost O(n log n), so the whole sort is O(n log n) - and the alarm budget is set from exactly that.
